node.title: Rate-half distance-three corrected-square converse
node.statement: On the official exceptional-only quotient-distance-three chart, exact row divisibility Q(z;x)|P(z) over every saturated row and exact ordinary-fiber divisibility Q(z;X)|P_X reconstruct both complement equations by coefficientwise interpolation. Primitivity then forces the two-sided weld. Hence the corrected complement square and all proved reciprocal/resultant/Bezout descendants are automatic consequences of the exact pair-Lagrange split design; only realization/exclusion of that design and an exact original column-far lift remain independent.
